title: ContextPack
description: The pack field of a POST /v2/context response context (SV2-CTX-03). max_tokens bounds the packed items; the omitted list and this block sit outside it and hold at most one entry per ranked item, itself capped by budget.max_items. Conflicted items are packed together or omitted together. Each packed item keeps its ranked fields and adds complete, reference and, unless conflicted, supporting_source_ids (see $defs.PackedItemFields).

category_tokens.description: Per-category shares of max_tokens applied in a first pass in rank order; tokens a category leaves unused are released to remaining items, still in rank order, within max_tokens.

category_spent.description: Tokens packed per category; may exceed category_tokens when released tokens were used. Sums to context_pack_tokens.

context_pack_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the packed items, never above max_tokens.

omitted.description: Items left out, in rank order. A duplicate is a repeated claim (same type, same title ignoring case, whitespace and ASCII punctuation) folded into the higher ranked item, which lists every supporting_source_ids; conflicted items are never folded.

truncated.description: True when any item was omitted over budget. Item text is never cut: an item is packed whole or listed in omitted.

knowledge_revision.description: Hash of the ranked items (id, revision, knowledge status, title) for this request before packing. It does not depend on max_tokens, so a smaller retry budget reports the same revision; max_items is part of the ranked scope and a different max_items may report a different revision.

complete.description: True when the item text is whole; false only for degraded reference entries, which carry no text.

supporting_source_ids.description: This item id and every repeated claim folded into it, in rank order.
